prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.5% average after noise correction), winning 2 out of 3 tests though one test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.0% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -6.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Split view for story intro screen: Redesign the story introduction screen with a split layout to visually present the desktop pet concept alongside welcoming story copy. (why: The choose_path step has a large mean time (514s) and drops off users early. Clear visual story layout helps engage users quickly.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop companion preview welcome screen: Add a dedicated new preview screen right before home_intro showing interactive animation of the pet arriving on desktop. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support emails indicate users are confused about how pets appear and behave on the desktop.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout redesign for pick friend screen: Redesign pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid with choice card components showing pet previews. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the early flow (60.9%) and long median time (89s).)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive pet traits quiz flow: Insert a new interactive personality quiz screen into the path selection flow to guide users to their ideal pet path. (why: Choosing a path takes a long average time (mean 514s), indicating hesitation or confusion on how to proceed.)
4: [home, wait_info] Time estimate and progress on generation screen: Show an explicit progress bar and estimated generation time counter on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting stage has median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to leave before setup completes.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop placement helper hint on home intro: Add a persistent helper hint box on the home_intro screen explaining how pet controls and desktop visibility work. (why: Support mail highlights 3 bug reports about pets not appearing on desktop and 3 confusion reports about pet controls.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Simplified single sign-in callout copy: Update sign_in copy to clearly state that signing in saves your desktop pet to your cloud account. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing account sync confusion.)
7: [home, notification] Background generation ready notification toggle: Add a system notification option on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generates. (why: Waiting times are long (mean 2336s), leading to app abandonment before setup finishes.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Photo upload guidance and quality incentive hint: Add helpful photo quality tips and visual guidance on upload_photos screen to improve creation success. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results.)
9: [sign_in, redesign] Compact step counter redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign sign_in layout to compact style with step counter display to reassure users sign-in is quick. (why: Sign-in conversion is 80.4% but mean time is 567s, suggesting hesitation at account creation.)
